diagnosis.root_cause: a service-discovery configuration reload caused the health-check subsystem to return empty results for 30% of services, resulting in widespread 'no healthy instances' errors for dependencies that were actually up
evidence: The platform team applied a service-discovery config change this morning.
2026-12-15T10:00:00Z  service-discovery  WARN  config reload applied; catalog re-sync in progress

diagnosis.recommended_fix: Since the service-discovery service has already rolled back the config reload and restored backends as indicated by subsequent logs, no further emergency mitigation is required. Follow up by auditing the config reload parser and health-check subsystem to prevent future empty result sets during reloads.
